author: reek
body: Stage one of build/test-quote-from-store.ps1. It writes one signed work into the fact store on the attached disk, so that stage two can compile a source that QUOTES that work with no offered-works blob -- the work travels on the block device, not beside the source.

author: reek
body: The work, its hash, its signer and its signature are lifted verbatim from codex/test/quotes-gate.codex, where the same quotation is proven to pass the import gate through the blob. Reusing them means the only thing under test in stage two is that FactDisk reads from the disk what the app-side writer wrote to it: a drift in the on-disk format shows up as a refused quotation, not a quiet miscompile.
